{{Top|leg}}
A '''blood stylus''' was a sharp writing utensil used for scribing documents. An individual would prick themselves with the sharp end of the device so as to draw [[Blood/Legends|blood]], which was then used in place of ink to compose their document. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] kept a blood stylus on her person which, when the need arose, she used to write on sheets of [[loub-paper]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
